overview: This single-page Department of State filing aid lists and cross-references reports concerning labor conditions, particularly current wages, in the Kwantung Leased Territory and Dalian (then called Dairen). It records reports dated October 16, 1931, and February 13, 1934, identifies Vincent in connection with the latter, and directs researchers to related documents in files 800.5041/35 and 800.5041/56.

people.name: Vincent
people.role: Reporting official associated with the February 13, 1934 Dairen report; precise position not stated

subfiles.title: List of papers and cross-references on wages in Kwantung and Dairen
subfiles.about: A filing sheet lists two labor reports and directs researchers to related reports on current wages in the Kwantung Leased Territory and Dairen.
subfiles.summary: The sheet records a report from Dairen dated October 16, 1931, and another Dairen item associated with Vincent dated February 13, 1934. Notes indicate that the required report on current wages in the Kwantung Territory was filed at 800.5041/35 and that a report on current wages in Dairen was filed at 800.5041/56. The first occurrence of “Lairen” is evidently an OCR misreading of “Dairen.”

interest: The sheet is useful chiefly as an archival roadmap: it shows that substantive wage reports were removed from or cross-filed outside this subject bundle. Its pairing of 1931 and 1934 reports provides evidence of recurring State Department monitoring of labor costs in Japanese-controlled Dalian and the wider Kwantung Leased Territory, while the file references allow the underlying reports to be located elsewhere in the decimal file.
